The compact silhouette makes it useful as a standalone seat or as part of a coordinated living room arrangement. Pocket coil seating and supportive foam cushioning create a soft yet resilient sit, while attached cushions help the chair maintain a neat tailored profile with regular use. Add this chair where comfortable lounging, clean styling, and a versatile black finish are needed.

Dimensions: 39"w x 35"d x 40.25"h

  • Attached cushions help maintain a neat tailored look over time
  • Pocket coil seat construction supports lasting comfort through daily use
  • Padded headrest and arms create a cozy supportive seating experience
  • Works alone or with matching upholstery for a cohesive room setting
  • Accent chair in black leatherette adds compact comfort to living spaces
  • Subtle tufting on the back adds understated detail to the clean profile
